# Audit: traces-icse-r3c-20261101 (audit_r3c.py, generated files)

Demand model r3c_model.py: contend_lib capacity x kappa (synthetic 7b 1.2 / 8b 1.05 / 14b 1.0; Real 0.85 / 0.95 / 1.0), 30 s windows sliding by 10 s from t = 30 s. need = sum tp x ceil(rho / 0.85) (GPUs that keep every model <= 85 % of its knee); rho* = best layout inside 8 GPUs (max rho / n; <= 1 = dynamic can hold); oracle moves = GPUs a model gains that are not free (taken from a shrinking model) when the layout follows need (or rho* when need > 8); static = the best FIXED full-pool layout with hindsight, and the layouts the baselines held in the replaced runs; rise = steepest 30 s / previous 60 s rate (Azure week max 2.16 code / 1.80 conv). Sims (orientation only): static = best fixed layout; free_only = arrival-driven, 3 s late, 30 s window, only free GPUs (TokenScale-like); donor = 10 s window 10 s late + queue, +1 per 5 s, takes a GPU from the least loaded model when the pool is full (TRE-like); late = arrivals waiting > 0.5 s.
